claim_scores.rationale: Uses `dspy.ChatAdapter().format(...)` directly on demos and inputs, and never calls an LM.
Creates an incomplete demo with one input (`passage`) and one output (`answer`), matching the kept-incomplete-demo condition.
Prints the formatted `messages` and asserts the incomplete demo user message contains `some input or output fields are not supplied`.
Asserts the incomplete demo assistant message contains `Not supplied for this particular example.`, showing an explicit placeholder rather than an empty string.
Also asserts later messages contain complete-demo values like `Another passage.` and `line 1`, confirming the complete demo is retained too.
